correctness.rationale: The source defines all 14 vertices and 21 undirected edges; base-three enumeration covers every one of 4782969 states without repetitions. Indegree peeling is a standard exact functional-graph cycle decomposition, and reverse peeling gives the correct first entry and least period for every removed state. A separately coded memoized-trajectory enumeration on an alternative Fano-plane incidence presentation returned identical 55-class counts; an additional direct Python witness checker verified all eight periods and a sharp ten-step preperiod. All integer totals reconcile, including 21099 periodic states and 12096 maximal-delay period-four states. The finite count is exhaustive, not a sample extrapolation.

value.rationale: The unique 14-vertex cubic girth-six cage is a mathematically canonical test object with 4782969 deterministic ternary states. The exact temporal fingerprint (eight distinct primitive periods, 55 positive entry/period classes, sharp ten-step transient, and maximal-delay states confined exclusively to period four) is a motivated natural invariant that qualitative activity theorems and graph girth do not determine. This is a self-contained complete finite classification, not an arbitrary parameter slice or a routine tiny table.
